packageRules.description: Automerge everything but majors once the required checks are green (CI and Trivy, REQUIRED_CHECKS in platform scripts/devsecops/bootstrap.sh). main is not production: a release is a v* tag (the wheel published to the Gitea PyPI), and consumers take a range. Majors keep the dependency-dashboard approval from the preset; minimumReleaseAge (3 days) still applies. Gitea merges through its own auto-merge when the checks pass (platformAutomerge).
